video_title: LeBron SIGNS With Philly! Why Didn’t He Return To Miami + What’s Next For The Lakers?

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid faces championship pressure this year and next
quotes.excerpt: There's never been pressure on Joel Embiid to be a championship contender more than it is this year
quotes.quote: There's never been pressure on Joel Embiid to be a championship contender more than it is this year and next year.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the definition of legacy and player autonomy
quotes.excerpt: Legacy is what other people think about you. And one of the freest things is saying I'm going to do what I want
quotes.quote: Legacy is what other people think about you. And one of the freest things is saying I'm going to do what I want and I don't give a f*ck what other people think about me.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia is a top-three aggressive team in free agency
quotes.excerpt: If you were talking about some of the most aggressive teams when it came to this summer's free agency, you would say Philly might be top three
quotes.quote: If you were talking about some of the most aggressive teams when it came to this summer's free agency, you would say Philly might be top three with Toronto and Miami, and maybe Minnesota. So with that attitude, you go, let's look top to bottom. They're ready to win. Do they have star power for sure? Do they have great guards? Yep. Do you have a great big man, when healthy? And Joel Embiid, you got to think, I think last year was the first year he hadn't played with a knee brace, I think in like almost seven years or six years. So you would hope his health is getting better.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown and Tyrese Maxey provide star power for Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: Here you go Jaylen Brown, here you go Tyrese Maxey. I'll get my little 15, 15, 7 and 7
quotes.quote: Here you go Jaylen Brown, here you go Tyrese Maxey. I'll get my little 15, 15, 7 and 7, go about my business and we're going to win by 30. Is it the obvious choice? No, but is it when you deep dive it, is it the choice if you want to compete every night for a win? For sure, because they also got some dogs in VJ Ed's comb and some guys coming off the bench, KCP, that you know, they're still continuing to add.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse's ability to manage diverse personalities on a team
quotes.excerpt: Nick Nurse, one thing that's not taking into consideration is Nick Nurse is a beast
quotes.quote: Nick Nurse, one thing that's not taking into consideration is Nick Nurse is a beast. And so when you add all these personalities to a team, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, you know, Bron, VJ Ed's comb, you know, Jaylen Brown, you need a coach that can handle all that that's going to put them in the right situation. A lot of them, everyone's going to talk about usage rate, but Nick Nurse made it work in Toronto with, you know, OG Anunoby, Pascal Siakam, Kyle Lowry and Kawhi Leonard.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson argues that a player's legacy should be winning
quotes.excerpt: Your legacy should be winning. Everybody, oh you did it with one team, or you did this, or blah blah. Your legacy should be winning
quotes.quote: Your legacy should be winning. Everybody, oh you did it with one team, or you did this, or blah blah. Your legacy should be winning. I did see something, I don't remember who said it, they're like, you're not ring chasing if you bring the ring.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The immense physical effort required to maintain performance at age 40
quotes.excerpt: People don't understand how hard you have to work just to maintain your level of decline
quotes.quote: People don't understand how hard you have to work just to maintain your level of decline. So you're going to work seven hours a day to go average 20 points, 19 points. You're going to work 92 hours to go and and play 75 games. Not to go be an MVP, not to go average 30 points a game, it's just, just to keep your body together to go be functional and that gets harder and harder.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of a potential LeBron and Paul George trade
quotes.excerpt: If after Bron had joined and they would have announced the trade that they're trading Paul George for Jaylen Brown
quotes.quote: If after Bron had joined and they would have announced the trade that they're trading Paul George for Jaylen Brown, those odds would have shot the hell up. Those odds would have changed. So what I'm saying is it's the total accumulation. It wasn't just Bron. It's that they have Jaylen Brown also on their team and what they gave up to get him. It's that they have VJ and they have Tyrese. So I'm saying if you would have reversed it and Bron would have been first, the odds would have looked like 1800.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston would not have traded Jaylen Brown if LeBron was there
quotes.excerpt: Boston would have never traded Jaylen Brown to the 76ers if LeBron was on the team
quotes.quote: Boston would have never traded Jaylen Brown to the 76ers if LeBron was on the team. They would have never just basically put them in a situation like that.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: The perception of Joel Embiid's contract as untradeable
quotes.excerpt: People were saying Joel Embiid's contract is one of the most untradeable things in the league
quotes.quote: People were saying Joel Embiid's contract is one of the most untradeable things in the league. They were saying Jaylen Brown is this and that and he's not a good teammate and all of a sudden, all that goes out the window when you get a 42-year-old LeBron and now you guys are this like all winning team. It's just like, it's amazing how the narrative changes.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson compares LeBron's career path to Tim Duncan's
quotes.excerpt: Tim Duncan signed a two-year deal and played one. One of the two. Just to eliminate the BS
quotes.quote: Tim Duncan signed a two-year deal and played one. One of the two. Just to eliminate the BS. I'm just saying, there there is a school of thought. Let's say there is a school of thought, let's play fantasy land. If Philly were to have a championship run and win a championship, that would be how I would see him going out, calling it a day.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson's philosophy on legacy and the love of the game
quotes.excerpt: I don't believe legacy matters. At the end of the day, if you're making your life decisions on legacy
quotes.quote: I don't believe legacy matters. At the end of the day, if you're making your life decisions on legacy and not basketball, not the love of the game, the love of the game is the most important. You can't get riled up to play basketball at 40 plus years old if you don't love the game. If you don't love to compete. If you're worried about legacy, legacy is what other people think about you. That's what legacy is. And one of the freest things is saying, I'm going to do what I want and I don't give a f*ck what other people think about me. End of the story.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron's career moves consistently shift the league's competitive landscape
quotes.excerpt: The goalposts moves every time he makes a decision. If he would have went to Golden State, it'll gross
quotes.quote: The goalposts moves every time he makes a decision. If he would have went to Golden State, it'll gross. If he would have went to a Cavs, oh he's stacking teams. Let's say he went to Houston, oh you're stacking teams. So no matter what decision he makes, half of the people are going to think it's bullshit anyway. So you might as well do what you want. And that's what he's doing. So his legacy, what you going to do? You can't argue with numbers and facts. And no player has moved the needle for as many teams as he has in his career. And that's a fact.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Robert Parish's longevity and impact at age 41
quotes.excerpt: Think about Robert Parish was 41 in NBA. Nobody was caring where Robert Parish was going
quotes.quote: Think about Robert Parish was 41 in NBA. Nobody was caring where Robert Parish was going. It wasn't like, oh, where Robert Parish is going to, hey, when he gets on your team, he's a championship contender.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on LeBron's unique career and longevity
quotes.excerpt: We've never seen a player like him, from his career, from his ability, from his longevity
quotes.quote: We've never seen a player like him, from his career, from his ability, from his longevity. So for me, I look at it, he can play point guard. He can play point guard there. Like then you can do a million different things. I don't know if Philly's done. You know, I don't know what their assets look like. I don't know what their story is, but I wouldn't be surprised if they found a little bit more just to give protection for Joel Embiid.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' defensive strategy against Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks were the only team that went at Joel Embiid defensively, right? Now obviously that's a health thing
quotes.quote: The Knicks were the only team that went at Joel Embiid defensively, right? Now obviously that's a health thing, obviously that's mobility, but the Knicks are built to go at Joel Embiid where these other teams are like, how do we guard him? The Knicks are like, well, we have two or three guys that can guard him as best as we can. I think now you add, and let me rewind this. Think about a whole season when you got a guy like Jaylen Brown who obviously takes care of his body, he's doesn't really have big injuries, knock on wood, ever in his career. He's a workhorse. Then you add LeBron James, another workhorse. So instead of just having Tyrese Maxey be that guy that comes into the gym and works out every day, you have two more guys building a culture of we're trying to get better every single day.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: The pressure on Joel Embiid to be a championship contender
quotes.excerpt: There's never been pressure on Joel Embiid to be a championship contender more than it is this year
quotes.quote: There's never been pressure on Joel Embiid to be a championship contender more than it is this year and next year. So all that, what is he eating? How is he working out? What is all this? No, homie, that shit's out the window because it's just going to get amplified. So you think you're not going to go in the gym and shoot with LeBron's around and Jaylen Brown's around? Not going to happen. You think you're not going to take care of your body? Not going to happen.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's impact as a first-team All-NBA player
quotes.excerpt: They added a first team all NBA player who will be all star caliber for five more years
quotes.quote: They added a first team all NBA player who will be all star caliber for five more years. So they got the short term, they got Anthony Simons. So they got shooting and scoring off the bench. They got KCP, they got they got shooting and defense off the bench. You add, um, you add a Dean Wade. They've got they've got another defensive hybrid four-five guy that can knock down shots. So when I look at short term, LeBron add, yes. Long term, Jaylen Brown could be the best player on your team for at least another five years.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Lakers' roster construction and future potential with Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: When you're building around Luka, who's one of the top five players on the planet, you're built
quotes.quote: When you're building around Luka, who's one of the top five players on the planet, you're built, you know, Austin Reaves, you know, you've added him. So they have their core. Now they've got to figure out the puzzle pieces around them. And I do believe they have picks still that they they have available if they want to can, you know, if a rolling big comes in, a lob threat of a big comes in, there's different options, but I wouldn't are the Lakers in that mix this year? No. Are they two years away from, and because it takes time to build a championship roster. Yes. Do they have that window of time with Luka? Yes, they have that window of time. They got a decade with Luka as a top 10 player on the planet, given health, given all these things. So they have a window.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye's assessment of the Minnesota Timberwolves' roster
quotes.excerpt: I think Detroit did. Detroit did some good things, bolstered their bench, got some shooters
quotes.quote: I think Detroit did. Detroit did some good things, bolstered their bench, got some shooters, continue to build culture. I think Detroit's going to be really good this year. And I think all this Jaylen Brown talk, I think we need to slow our roll. My guy is 22 years old. Yeah. And we're saying, hey, we just need you to score. You're scoring 20, we need you to score 25. You're like, god, give him a summer. Relax everybody. Pay the man the money. He's a dog and just trust the process. Just because if you don't pay him, you'll be mad when he's on another team.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Allie Clifton on her experience in the State Farm 3-Point Contest
quotes.excerpt: I was a part of the 3-point contest, the actual one, years ago and the same thing happened.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton

And she was like, Allie, I was a part of the 3-point contest, the actual one, years ago and the same thing happened. She goes, I'm not a rack shooter.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: And I'm like, I get it. I'm not a WNBA player, I've never made it to this level.

text_blocks.text: You and Kelsey tied. Well, my goal, as far as I'm concerned, I beat Kelsey Plum also. So we're, as a, you know, it's all on a sliding scale between professional and non-professional. So she's a professional, I'm not one. So technically, we beat Kelsey Plum. Cheers.
